# Sean Croston Joins Pega as Chief Information Security Officer


Pega appoints financial services security executive to oversee security strategy and implementation


**WALTHAM, Mass. – October 13, 2026 –**[Pegasystems Inc.](https://www.pega/com) (NASDAQ: PEGA), the enterprise AI software company for mission-critical work, today announced it has appointed[Sean Croston](https://www.linkedin.com/in/sean-b-croston) as chief information security officer. Mr. Croston will be responsible for comprehensive information security standards and policies.


Mr. Croston joins Pega with more than 30 years of experience in cybersecurity, information security, risk management, fraud prevention, and financial services technology. He will oversee Pega’s information security strategy and implementation, including risk management programs spanning information security, physical security, business continuity, crisis management, privacy, and compliance. Mr. Croston will work closely with the company’s product development, IT, compliance, and cloud teams to help safeguard Pega’s global assets and maintain a best-in-class security environment for clients.


Most recently, Mr. Croston served as chief information security officer at USAA and previously held CISO leadership roles at Truist, BNP Paribas/Bank of the West, and Santander US. Earlier in his career, Sean held senior leadership positions at the Federal Reserve Bank of New York, State Street, JPMorgan Chase, and several technology startups, where he helped drive security strategy, regulatory compliance, risk management, and digital transformation initiatives across global organizations.


Mr. Croston received a Bachelor of Science from Bentley University in Waltham, Mass., where he will be based at Pega’s headquarters. He is a published author and co-patent holder in the security space. He has also been a speaker and panelist at regulatory and industry events throughout his career.


**Quotes & Commentary:**
“Pega powers the workflows and decisions at the heart of the world’s leading organizations, making security, resilience, and trust fundamental to helping clients continuously evolve their operations,” said Ken Stillwell, chief financial officer and chief operating officer, Pega. “Sean’s deep experience leading security programs at some of the world’s largest financial institutions will help ensure Pega continues to uphold a best-in-class approach to protecting our business, our clients, and the mission-critical work they depend on us to deliver.”


“Pega has earned a strong reputation for helping organizations modernize how they operate and engage with customers, and that reputation depends on our ability to be a secure and reliable partner,” said Mr. Croston. “I look forward to advancing Pega’s security strategy and working across the organization to help ensure our clients can confidently rely on Pega to run, evolve, and protect their business operations.”
